item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in Saudi Arabia on Monday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: USD/INR ticks lower at open as US SC strikes down Trump’s tariff policy
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR ticks down to near 90.86 as the US Dollar (USD) has come under pressure, following the United States (US) Supreme Court’s (SC) ruling against President Donald Trump’s tariff policy.

item.title: USD/CHF softens below 0.7750 as Swiss Franc strengthens amid tariff uncertainty
item.description: The USD/CHF pair faces some selling pressure to around 0.7725 during the early European session on Monday. US President Donald Trump’s fresh tariff plans weigh on the Greenback against the Swiss Franc (CHF).

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Turns upside down after facing selling pressure above 0.7100
item.description: The AUD/USD pair gives back its early gains after facing selling pressure above 0.7100 and falls 0.23% to near 0.7065 during the late Asian trading session on Monday. The Aussie pair turns upside down as the Australian Dollar (AUD) underperforms across the board.

item.title: DXY: Tariff shock weighs on Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB Global Economics & Markets Research notes that the US Dollar weakened after the Supreme Court ruled President Trump had exceeded his authority on earlier global tariffs, even as new 15% tariffs were announced under a different law.

item.title: Gold clings to gains near monthly peak amid flight to safety and weak USD
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to its bullish bias near the monthly peak heading into the European session on Monday and looks to build on last week's breakout through the $5,100 mark amid a supportive fundamental backdrop.

item.title: NZD/USD surrenders some early gains even as US Dollar remains fragile
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gives back half of its early gains during the early European trading session on Monday after facing selling pressure above the psychological barrier of 0.6000.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD strengthens to near 1.3520 during Asian session
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gains traction to around 1.3520 during the early Asian session on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) faces some selling pressure against the Cable as tariff uncertainty lingers.

item.title: Pound Sterling holds gains above 1.3500 amid stronger UK data, US tariff uncertainty
item.description: The GBP/USD pair holds positive ground near 1.3520 during the early European session on Monday. The major pair recovers after falling to four-week lows last week amid renewed concerns over US tariffs.

item.title: USD: Tariff chaos clouds policy outlook – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes that recent US Supreme Court rulings have thrown US tariff policy into disarray, with President Trump responding by announcing and then raising a new global tariff.
